scripts.build:web: pnpm run version:check && pnpm --dir frontend run build
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --exclude thelxinoe-desktop --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:python
scripts.test:ui:player: pnpm run build:web && playwright test --config playwright.ui.config.ts --project player
scripts.test:ui:layout: pnpm run build:web && playwright test --config playwright.ui.config.ts --project layout
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend scripts tests package.json .github README.md docs pnpm-workspace.yaml playwright*.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend scripts tests package.json .github README.md docs pnpm-workspace.yaml playwright*.config.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm run check && pnpm test && pnpm run build:web
scripts.validate:web: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run build:web
scripts.test:ui: pnpm run build:web && playwright test --config playwright.ui.config.ts
